name: ioreum-saju
description: Deterministic Korean saju (Four Pillars, 사주팔자·만세력) charts: solar-term boundaries computed astronomically to the minute, true solar time from the birthplace, 10-year luck pillars (대운), the zodiac-year boundary (띠), the Tojeong Bigyeol (토정비결) number of the year and a reference for the sixty day-pillar characters (일주). Read-only calculation tools; no account needed.

interface.longDescription:
ioreum calculates Korean saju (四柱, Four Pillars of Destiny) charts the way a professional would: solar-term boundaries computed astronomically to the minute, true solar time from the birthplace, and the late-night hour convention. Ask for a chart, the 10-year luck pillars (daeun), which zodiac animal a January or February birth really belongs to, the Tojeong Bigyeol number for the year, or a reference for any of the sixty day-pillar characters. Tools return calculated facts only and take nothing but the birth details you give them. Nothing here predicts events; treat it as reference and entertainment. Supported birth years: 1900 to 2050.

한국어로도 쓸 수 있습니다. 이오름은 사주팔자(만세력)를 계산해 드립니다 — 절기가 바뀌는 시각을 분 단위로, 자시(밤 11시 무렵)와 음력·윤달까지 반영합니다. 생년월일을 알려 주시면 사주 여덟 글자와 오행 분포, 10년 단위 대운, 입춘 기준의 띠, 그해의 토정비결 괘 번호, 60갑자 일주 사전을 찾아 드립니다. 도구는 계산값만 돌려주며, 알려 주신 생년월일 말고는 아무것도 받지 않습니다. 앞날을 예언하지 않습니다 — 참고와 재미로 봐 주세요.
capabilities: Calculate a saju / BaZi chart (사주 만세력)
Find the Tojeong Bigyeol number (토정비결 괘)
defaultPrompt: Calculate my saju chart - born 1994-03-08 at 14:30 in Seoul, female.
내 사주 봐 줘 - 1990년 5월 15일 오후 2시 30분 서울 출생, 남자

positive.prompt: Calculate my saju: born 1994-03-08 at 14:30 in Seoul, female.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the year, month, day and hour pillars (stem and branch each), the Day Master, the Five-Element distribution and a note on the true-solar-time adjustment applied to the birth hour.

positive.prompt: Same birth, 1994-03-08 in Seoul, but I don't know the hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three pillars and states the hour pillar is left out because the time is unknown, instead of guessing it.

positive.prompt: What are my 10-year luck pillars? Born 1988-11-21 at 06:10 in Busan, male.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the starting age and the list of ten-year pillars, with the direction (forward or backward) of the cycle.

positive.prompt: I was born on February 2, 1990. Am I a Snake or a Horse?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the saju year turns at ipchun (about February 4), so a February 2, 1990 birth belongs to the previous year's animal (Snake, 己巳), not the Horse.

positive.prompt: What is the 丙午 day pillar like?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the reference entry for the 丙午 day pillar (its name, epithet and Day Master element), presented as reference, not as a prediction.

positive.description: Tojeong Bigyeol number for the year
positive.prompt: What is my Tojeong Bigyeol number for 2027? Born 1990-05-15 (solar).
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the three-digit gwae number 163 for 2027 with its name and verse, the lunar birth date used, and the three steps of the count (age + year number, month length + month number, birth day + day number).

positive.prompt: 내 사주 봐 줘 - 1990년 5월 15일 오후 2시 30분 서울 출생, 남자
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the same chart data; the day pillar is 庚辰. For a Korean-locale user the result also carries the Korean readings of the pillars and reference links to the Korean pages of the same site.

negative.description: Event prediction is declined; the tools only calculate charts
negative.prompt: Will I get the job I interviewed for next month?

negative.description: Birth years outside 1900-2050 are rejected rather than invented
negative.prompt: Calculate the saju chart for someone born on 1850-01-01.

negative.description: No reading from chat history; only explicit birth details are accepted
negative.prompt: Here is my friend's whole chat history - read her fortune from it.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Tools return calculated chart data only.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0 - Adds one read-only tool, tojeong_gwae (the Tojeong Bigyeol number of the year). Korean-locale users now get Korean readings of the pillars and reference links to the Korean pages. Listing text adds Korean. Still no auth, no UI components, no commerce.

ko-KR.subtitle: 정확한 만세력으로 보는 사주·토정비결
ko-KR.description:
이오름은 사주팔자(만세력)를 계산해 드립니다. 절기가 바뀌는 시각을 분 단위로, 자시와 음력·윤달까지 반영합니다.
생년월일을 알려 주시면 사주 여덟 글자와 오행 분포, 10년 단위 대운, 입춘 기준의 띠, 그해의 토정비결 괘 번호, 60갑자 일주 사전을 찾아 드립니다.
도구는 계산값만 돌려주며, 알려 주신 생년월일 말고는 아무것도 받지 않습니다. 앞날을 예언하지 않습니다 — 참고와 재미로 봐 주세요. 지원하는 출생 연도: 1900~2050년.
